svg.title: Sechang's technology orbit
svg.desc: Sechang is fixed at the center. The solid inner orbit shows project implementation and integration experience: Python, FastAPI, Pydantic, pytest, Supabase, PostgreSQL, TypeScript, React, Docker, Git, Qwen3-TTS, and Ollama. The dashed outer orbit shows practice and exploration: PyTorch, Streamlit, LangGraph, n8n, and Langfuse. Both orbits turn slowly clockwise while every logo and label stays upright. Motion stops when reduced motion is preferred. The README below includes the full technology list.
